evidence_scope: CPU scalar address/query-only engineering evidence; no resident, updated, spiking, token-throughput, GPU, or capability claim

acceptance.no_material_scale_slope: Operationalized by both fixed-query-time and traced-memory max/min ratios being at most 2.0; log-log slopes are reported descriptively.
acceptance.ratio_definition: For each topology and metric, max over N divided by min over N across 10^6, 10^9, and 10^11.
required_invariants: Every valid descriptor and base-edge row query succeeds.
Every invalid descriptor and base-edge row query raises TypeError or ValueError.
Every row has six in-range targets with no self target and no duplicate target.
The 100-billion case samples GIDs immediately below, at, and above 2^32.
Every ScaleAccounting record reports configured=addressable=N and resident=updated=spiking=0.
Configured base edges equal N*fanout; resident and mutable edges are zero; generated edges equal exactly 72 examined returned edges.

counter_rng.endianness: Counters, keys, and results are numeric uint64 v[0],v[1] words, not byte strings; frozen target-GID reference serialization is unsigned 8-byte little-endian.
counter_rng.variant: D. E. Shaw Research Random123 Philox2x64_R<10>

descriptor_contract.intrinsic_model_scope: Every descriptor uses the same pinned Allen human GLIF5 intrinsic fit.
descriptor_contract.outgoing_connectivity_role: One deterministic inhibitory label when the topology-independent Philox role word is below floor(2^64/5), otherwise excitatory.
descriptor_contract.wiring_role_caveat: Dale-like outgoing wiring metadata only; it does not claim distinct inhibitory dynamics or molecular E/I biology.

execution_guard.artifact_policy: Refuse before subprocess launch if the destination exists, then use exclusive-create mode for the final write.
execution_guard.confirmation_rule: The supplied confirmation must exactly equal SHA-256 of the raw protocol file bytes.
execution_guard.default_mode: Print the plan and raw protocol SHA-256; do not start a worker or write an artifact.
execution_guard.guard_order: Protocol confirmation and destination nonexistence are checked before git subprocesses, worker subprocesses, or artifact writes.

hypotheses: All valid, invalid, fixed-fanout, range, no-self, and no-duplicate invariants pass for every topology and configured count.
For each topology, fixed-query median time and traced peak bytes each have max/min ratio at most 2.0 across 10^6, 10^9, and 10^11 configured IDs.
No result reports resident, updated, or spiking cells, cell-step work, delivered events, token throughput, GPU evidence, or capability evidence.

measurement.checksum: SHA-256 of canonical JSON descriptor and target records.
measurement.memory: tracemalloc peak Python allocation bytes during manifest construction and fixed queries; not RSS or resident cell state.
measurement.process_isolation: One fresh subprocess per configured cell count; all topology families run inside that subprocess.
measurement.time: perf_counter_ns for construction and each fixed descriptor-plus-edge-row query; report median and maximum query latency.

protocol.name: procedural-address-space-v1
notes: This is an explicit protocol break from the legacy NumPy global-RNG materialized arrays. There is no compatibility version, fallback, or claim of exact legacy seeded rows.
The artifact is address/query-only engineering evidence. It is not a resident or updated simulation and must not report tokens per second.
The 4D hypercube is an abstract functional lattice, not an anatomical claim.
protocol.purpose: Gate 1 and Gate 2 CPU scalar engineering evidence for deterministic uint64 cell and immutable base-edge address queries.

sampling_without_replacement.fallback: Map the row-level Philox counter [source_gid, (0 << 16) | (255 << 8) | 0] to one global start GID, then advance one wrapped cursor shared by all edge slots; the cursor is never reset or revisited.
sampling_without_replacement.fallback_work_bound: Across the whole row, at most fanout + 1 fallback GIDs and at most 129*fanout + 1 total candidates are examined because the used set contains only the source plus earlier targets.
